title: 17-Layer Defect Cavity with Central SiO2 Defect
scientific_hypothesis: A periodic DBR stack with a central defect layer creates a resonant transmission peak in the 8-13 μm band while the DBR mirrors suppress emission in the 3-5 μm band through photonic bandgap reflection.
design_principle: Quarter-wave DBR mirrors (HfO2/SiO2 pairs) bracketing a half-wave or full-wave SiO2 defect layer create a microcavity resonance. The defect thickness controls the resonant wavelength position within the stopband.
proposed_topology: Air | [HfO2/SiO2]_4 | SiO2_defect | [HfO2/SiO2]_4 | Si_substrate. Total 17 finite layers: 8 DBR layers + 1 defect + 8 DBR layers.
manufacturing_considerations: Thickness tolerance ±5% acceptable for cavity resonance
HfO2 and SiO2 compatible with standard deposition
theory_basis: Transfer Matrix Method for multilayer interference
Kirchhoff's law: emissivity equals absorptance at thermal equilibrium
Defect mode theory in 1D photonic crystals
expected_advantages: Sharp spectral selectivity from cavity resonance
known_risks: Cavity resonance may be too narrow for full 8-13 μm coverage
Thickness sensitivity may reduce fabrication tolerance
SiO2 absorption in mid-IR may limit peak emissivity
execution_request_english: Design a 17-layer defect cavity stack on silicon substrate with air incidence. Structure: Air | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | SiO2_defect | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | Si. Optimize all 17 layer thicknesses (bounds 200-3000 nm) to maximize emissivity in 8000-13000 nm band while minimizing emissivity in 3000-5000 nm band. Use normal incidence, unpolarized light. Materials: HfO2 (high index), SiO2 (low index and defect layer). Total layer count exactly 17 finite layers. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 3000-5000 nm, 8000-13000 nm. soft objectives: high emissivity in 8000-13000 nm; low emissivity in 3000-5000 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high emissivity in 3000-5000 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layer count not exceeding 24.
revision_reason: Repair compilation failure: prior route declared 1 layer but experiment expected 17. Now explicitly declaring 17-layer topology matching opt_cavity_dielectric_17layer template. Widened thickness bounds by 15% (from ~2600 to 3000 nm max) to reduce false-negative rejections from strict geometric margins.
